An astronomical object was the '''homeworld''' of the [[Morodin/Legends|Morodins]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|lizard]]-[[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]]. In order to support the growing population of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the Morodins established an [[Farm/Legends|agricultural]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]]<ref name="First Contact" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Varonat system/Legends|Varonat system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]<ref name="First Contact" /> around [[26,053 BBY]].<ref name="Varonat Date">"[[First Contact]]" states that [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]] was [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] 1,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|formation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[25,053 BBY]]. Thus the [[Morodin/Legends|Morodins]] must have settled Varonat around [[26,053 BBY]].</ref> The Morodin used [[organic space vessel]]s to transport the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] produced on Varonat back to their homeworld; however, they eventually lost their ability to create their organic [[Starship/Legends|starships]] following an [[Unidentified ecological disaster|ecological disaster]] on their homeworld. Following the disaster, the colony on Varonat was cut off and left to its own devices.<ref name="First Contact" /> By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="First Contact Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[First Contact]]" to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> the Morodins known to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] were from Varonat and knowledge of the Morodin homeworld had been lost.<ref name="First Contact" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Morodin homeworld was first mentioned in the short story "[[First Contact]]," written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1994]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="First Contact" />
